visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with dark hair and glasses, wearing a black tank top, stands in a modern, well-lit kitchen. He holds a large box of "brüst" coffee protein drinks. The background shows a clean, minimalist living space with a wooden dining table and white walls. (2) The man walks through the house, passing a glass display cabinet filled with numerous small colorful figurines. He moves towards a staircase with grey stone steps and white railings. The camera follows his movement, providing a first-person perspective of the home's layout. (3) He reaches a bedroom where a ginger cat is resting on a wooden shelf. He reaches out with his hand, which has a watch and a tattoo, to gently pet the cat's head. The room is bright with a bed and some toys visible. (4) On a balcony area with a glass roof, the man pours cat food from a blue bag into a white bowl. Several cats, including a grey and white one and a calico one, gather around to eat. The area is clean and sunlit. (5) The man is now in a room filled with collectibles, posters, and a yellow chair. He has changed into a white Dodgers baseball jersey and a black cap. He adjusts his glasses and speaks directly to the camera, looking enthusiastic. (6) He enters a garage and gets into a white Tesla. The camera shows the car's interior, including the large touchscreen and white seats. He drives through a residential area with traditional Taiwanese houses under a clear blue sky. (7) Walking down a narrow street, the man carries a white plastic bag of food and a large bottle of Coca-Cola. He is still wearing the Dodgers jersey and cap. The lighting suggests it is late afternoon or early evening. (8) He enters a room decorated for a birthday. There are blue and white balloons, a "HAPPY BIRTHDAY" banner, and a wall covered with photos of a child. A young boy in a matching blue Dodgers shirt is playing on the floor. (9) The boy sits at a table and watches a video on a smartphone. The video shows a newborn baby in a hospital setting. A woman in a beige top stands next to him, watching the video as well. (10) A white cake topped with fresh strawberries is placed on the table. The boy uses a blue plastic knife to cut a slice. He takes a small piece of dark chocolate, eats it, and makes a funny, disgusted face, causing the adults to laugh.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 這天是happy生日 他這幾天都住在外公外婆家. [Logo]: 人類發展協會. (2) [Subtitle]: 最近地震頻繁 家裡的扭蛋櫃早已面目全非. (3) [Subtitle]: 泡妃又在等我上樓 因為她想吃我倒的飼料. (4) [Subtitle]: 阿湯❤️. (5) [Subtitle]: 泡妃還忘了自己是流浪貓 每天都會很職業病地來我房間門口討吃的 但是2樓明明有自動餵食機 她還是喜歡這樣的儀式感. (6) [Subtitle]: 今天岳父給Happy穿了大谷翔平的球帽跟衣服 所以我決定跟他穿父子裝. (7) [Subtitle]: 準備去市區拿披薩跟蛋糕. (8) [Subtitle]: 林太太花店的姑姑會幫Happy佈置生日場地 #花花花店. (9) [Subtitle]: 大家各司其職 準備出發. (10) [Subtitle]: 雖然林太太有訂披薩跟蛋糕 但我還是買了胖老爹 單純只是因為我想吃😂. (11) [Subtitle]: 他終於完成了他的夢想 林太太說他五歲之後就可以吃巧克力了. (12) [Subtitle]: 他媽媽特地幫他準備了100%的濃巧克力👍. (13) [Subtitle]: 他吃完的感想是... (14) [Variety]: 有點苦🤢. (15) [Variety]: 哈哈哈哈哈哈.
